# Release artifact adapters

These helpers acquire the explicitly selected legacy Triton wheel and summarize wheel-build, promotion or native-prebuild logs. A summary records its supplied inputs; it does not independently qualify or publish an artifact.

Start with the [release guide](../../../ci/release/README.md) for the complete process. The [script index](../README.md) lists the exact callers and responsibilities. Keep candidate identity and qualification decisions in the owning controller.
